title: Research-monograph controlled exercise program
status_detail: The manuscript-defined analytical and numerical exercise program is represented as an inactive planning DAG. Exercise implementation, external scientific software, material-specific DFT or Wannier calculations, scientific validation, automatic succession, and acceptance remain unauthorized.
objective: Develop dependency-ordered controlled exercises that expose representation, state-space mapping, alignment, reduction, convergence, and model-class requirements before material-specific first-principles work or scientific API hardening.
authorized_scope: Plan the complete lifecycle of the manuscript exercises using analytical examples and explicitly illustrative or synthetic numerical inputs.
Let repeated exercise requirements reveal candidate scientific software boundaries before any public API is frozen.
Keep software verification, numerical verification, scientific validation, and uncertainty quantification distinct for every exercise result.
completion_criteria: Actual retained results exist for the particle-in-a-box, harmonic-oscillator, one-dimensional periodic, two-dimensional periodic, and three controlled impurity warmups represented by the child Tasks.
The exercises identify reusable operations and metadata from demonstrated use rather than speculative API design.
Administrative closeout records limitations and leaves material-specific DFT, Wannier production, scientific acceptance, and automatic successor activation separate.
exclusions: Planning does not activate or implement any exercise.
No Quantum ESPRESSO or production Wannier90 calculation, remote execution, dependency change, scientific validation claim, publication, release, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
Parent containment, passing checks, or exercise completion does not authorize the bulk-silicon or doped-silicon production programs.
